purpose: Freeze the version-specific QEMU qualification usage surface used by the Legacy-first decision.

devicePropertiesSemantics.rule: deviceProperties lists only properties that this qualification usage profile permits Qman to render; it is not the complete vfio-pci help surface compiled into the QEMU binary. A binary-exposed property remains forbidden unless the selected profile lists it.

profiles.sourceObservation: vfio-pci properties contain a TODO for passed vfiofd/vfiogroupfd and expose host/sysfsdev instead
The same QEMU 10.2 binary may expose iommufd/fd when built with CONFIG_IOMMUFD, but the current Legacy qualification profile permits only host/sysfsdev and forbids rendering iommufd/fd.

qmanDecision.authorizationBoundary: Host Agent creates a per-VM device/sysfs namespace and cgroup/LSM allowlist containing only the leased group before exec; it verifies QEMU proc fds and QMP/QOM after spawn.
